nets.note: 1k series resistor to the LED anode.
Active low against the internal pull-up. RTC-capable, so it doubles as the deep-sleep wake source.

buses.pullup_source: 4k7 fitted on the BME280 breakout; nothing else on the bus carries one

required_pins.reason: Everything this build needs is allocated. Battery sense is not fitted: the cell voltage is reported by the charger board, not sampled by the MCU.
